Intro: When I got there, that thing was already standing over her. I was…terrified. I could barely move. I thought this was it, end of our luck.
I mocked my sister for her beliefs, but deep down, I felt the same. But I didn't see our encounters as trials, I saw them as a ticking bomb.
That pale man…I too thought he was death. An inevitable end, that Eve and I could not escape. But for some reason, a stranger stepped up to save us.
He faced the pale monster with determined eyes so we could escape...and once again, we ran. I'm tired of all this death, Chef. When will it end?
Success: He mentioned you, Chef. Said he was happy he met you. Thank you…if not for you we would not be here today. I promise I will repay the favor one day.
Fail: He mentioned you, Chef. Said he was happy he met you. Thank you…if not for you we would not be here today. I promise I will repay the favor one day.
Reject: Chef? What…what are you talking about? Is this a joke…? It has to be a joke, right?
